description: This file defines a React component for client-side navigation links in Next.js, including prefetching logic, URL resolution, and link behavior handling.

methods.name: prefetch
methods.description: Preloads page data for a given URL if on the client and URL is local.

methods.name: isModifiedEvent
methods.description: Checks if a mouse event involves modifier keys or is a middle click, indicating a modified event.

methods.name: linkClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on the link, performing client-side navigation via NextRouter.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: React component that renders a link with prefetching and client-side navigation logic.
